NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Synthetic executed Northbridge Term Loan covenant terms, current restatement
This invented agreement is test data, not evidence about a real issuer or legal advice.
Execution attestation: the Borrower and all lenders signed this restatement on December 30, 2025. It became effective on December 31, 2025 and remains operative without amendment or waiver through January 10, 2026. All earlier versions of these selected terms are superseded.
Clause 1.1. Borrower means Northbridge Synthetic Group, the issuer named in the Issuer identity and reporting scope note. This separate legal supplement establishes that Borrower only for this agreement; the two-source financial set did not establish a legal borrower, guarantor or restricted-group perimeter.
Clause 1.2. Group means exactly the IFRS consolidated group used in the unaudited quarterly and reported FY2025 financial statements published January 10, 2026. Group is the perimeter for this agreement's debt, cash, EBITDA and leverage test. No separate guarantor or restricted-group perimeter is established by the supplied agreement.
Clause 1.3. The agreement governs Northbridge Term Loan, facility_id term-loan, the sole senior secured term loan in the complete facility schedule. Its commitment is USD 50 million; it is fully drawn at December 31, 2025. Final contractual maturity remains December 31, 2029, and mandatory annual amortisation remains zero. This restatement does not increase the commitment or change that maturity.
Clause 1.4. The supplied pages contain the operative leverage test, selected definitions, debt permission and asset-sale condition only. Security enforcement, guarantee coverage, events of default, cure rights, voting and other protections are not supplied; no overall lender-protection conclusion may be inferred from their absence.

NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Current restatement: definitions and maintenance test
Clause 2.1. Covenant Debt means the Group's total debt at IFRS carrying value excluding both finance and operating lease obligations, with no other exclusions or pro-forma adjustments. For the test date all debt is the sole senior secured term loan; no other debt, lease debt or debt adjustment exists.
Clause 2.2. Eligible Cash means the Group's reported cash and cash equivalents that are unrestricted and freely available to service Group debt. At December 31, 2025 all reported cash and cash equivalents are eligible, restricted cash is zero, and there are no short-term investments or other cash-like deductions. Covenant Net Debt means Covenant Debt less Eligible Cash; negative net debt, if any, is not floored at zero.
Clause 2.3. Covenant EBITDA means the Group's reported EBITDA: revenue less cost of sales less function-only operating expenses including depreciation plus depreciation and amortization, over the trailing twelve months ending on the test date. No adjustments, add-backs, synergies, run-rate savings, pro-forma changes or exclusions are permitted. For December 31, 2025 the period is January 1 through December 31, 2025, identical to reported FY2025 and the four discrete calendar 2025 quarters. The underlying statements remain unaudited; this definition supplies no audit assurance.
Clause 3.1. The Borrower shall maintain the ratio of Covenant Net Debt to Covenant EBITDA at not more than 4.00x, tested at every calendar quarter end from December 31, 2025. The test applies to Northbridge Term Loan, facility_id term-loan, whether or not any amount is newly borrowed. The December 31, 2025 test uses closing net debt and trailing twelve-month Covenant EBITDA on the Group perimeter defined in Clause 1.2.

NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Current restatement: selected permissions and source limitations
Clause 4.1. Existing drawings under Northbridge Term Loan are permitted. Additional debt or an increase in that facility's commitment requires prior written consent of every lender. The maintenance leverage limit by itself is not a debt-incurrence permission or an available funding commitment. No additional automatic debt basket is provided by these selected terms.
Clause 5.1. Asset sales must be for fair market value. The Borrower is not required by these selected terms to apply asset-sale proceeds to mandatory debt prepayment, and no asset-sale sweep is provided. This provision does not establish that any asset sale occurred.
Source limitation. These are selected current executed terms, not a complete legal package. Obtain the omitted protections named in Clause 1.4 before rating the overall lender-protection package. Financial statements remain unaudited and consolidated; no borrower-only financial statements, guarantor perimeter or restricted-group financial information are supplied.

A later implementation lease may instead specify and independently review a precise guard; this source freeze grants no such code change.

semantic_acceptance.current_version_period_and_scope: Independently verify operative version, metric period/basis/perimeter and facility identity before acceptance; quote/threshold validity alone does not prove them.

unused_commitment_oracle.permission_limit: Neither zero undrawn funds nor USD90m arithmetic ratio distance establishes a new debt permission. Unanimous prior lender consent is required; no automatic additional debt basket.
